preconditions.description: The length of the strings s and t must be between 1 and 10^6.
The lengths of the strings s and t must be equal to n.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in s) and all(c in '01' for c in t)
preconditions.description: Both strings s and t must consist only of the characters '0' and '1'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not can_convert(s, t) else stdout == str(min_operations)
postconditions.description: If it is impossible to convert s to t, output '-1'; otherwise, output the minimum number of operations required.
